def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    shared = set(v for row in top for v in row) & set(v for row in bottom for v in row)
    bg = next(v for v in shared if v != 3) if shared else 0
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == bottom[r][c] and top[r][c] == bg else bg
             for c in range(len(top[0]))] for r in range(len(top))]

def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    candidates = [c for c in range(n) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1]
    sep = min(candidates, key=lambda c: abs(c - (n - 1) / 2))
    width = min(sep, n - sep - 1)
    left = [row[:width] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:sep + 1 + width] for row in grid]
    common = [left[r][c] for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(width) if left[r][c] == right[r][c]]
    bg = common[0] if common else 0
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else bg for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(grid))]
